sentence: From Hiding private notes, cloud sync, and making to do.
They claim to give you total anonymity and they never see messages or calls on their "encrypted servers" .
As I used all ok, but the call recording is .. only my voice is perfectly recorded.
I really love this app, specially because of graphs and charts, however I think it can be better by adding subtasks or improvement on graphical environment.
Habe a login option where all data of habits gets stored...
Edited: Since the update, developers noticed my review and solved some of my problems but only 1 thing, "People nearby" Hopefully this will be available.
They made recurring tasks a premium feature.
The developers are incapable of learning from their mistakes and customer feedback.

Until last month I had no problems with the app but nowadays when I open battery saver mode my alarms give this warning: "Battery saver might degrade your alarm and timer experience", instead of ringing.
